formula.market: Abar[year][day][t] = sum_{s_m} pi_m[year][s_m] * A[year][day][s_m, t], A in {cost_energy_p (EUR/MWh), cost_flex (EUR/MWh)}, pi_m = planning.prob_market_scenarios[year] (production _read_market_data_from_file: [1/NumMarketScenarios] * NumMarketScenarios)
formula.operation: Abar[net][year][day][device][t] = sum_{s_o} pi_o[s_o] * A[s_o, t], A in {load.pd, load.qd, load.flexibility.active_power.upward, .downward, load.flexibility.reactive_power.upward, .downward, generator.pg, generator.qg} (p.u. on the network baseMVA, as stored), pi_o = network.prob_operation_scenarios (production _read_network_data: [1/num_oper_scenarios] * n)
formula.joint_equivalence: equal to the joint mean over the 9 (s_m, s_o) pairs with weight pi_m * pi_o (production _scenario_probability) because each array depends on one dimension only and the other dimension's weights sum to 1; checked numerically
formula.evaluation: numpy float64, np.sum(w[:, None] * A, axis=0), w the production probability vector
formula.capture_point: arrays as stored at the entry of shared_resources_planning._compute_scenario_metadata (the production scenario-checksum point: TSO and DSOs read, ADN loads not yet zeroed, shared ESS not yet added); the post-read arrays are compared separately
formula.what_it_is_not: no re-derivation of power factor / Q-P ratio, no capacity clipping, no abs() of flexibility bounds (production applies abs() at model build), no re-sampling

energy_price_4h_spread.definition: mean(4 highest) - mean(4 lowest) hourly EUR/MWh; horizon = sum_b w_b spread_b / sum_b w_b, w_b = num_years * num_days

res_capacity.note: production skips the RES capability / power-factor rows and fixes pg to 0 where available apparent power <= EQUALITY_TOLERANCE (model_construction_helpers.renewable_generation_is_unavailable); the mean is "available" wherever ANY scenario is

years.note: per (network, year, day) the profile is a draw from the SEASON pool with a seed that depends on the year (network_data._read_network_data: derive_random_seed(network seed, "realization", year, day); _read_market_data_from_file: derive_random_seed(market seed, "selection", <type>, year, day)) times the growth factor (1+g)^(year - first year); SRP1 2030 / 2035 have no counterpart on the 3 x 3 grid

q3.loading_route: production reader (p515_s44_scale_measurement.read_planning_from_derived_case on the EV case) + the S56 injection hook (ScenarioHook, mode inject, means read from the profiles file) at shared_resources_planning._compute_scenario_metadata; production alone cannot load explicit profiles (it synthesizes them)

q5.rule: production search lattice p515_s47_phase_b_record.Lattice on years (2025, 2028, 2031, 2034, 2037), unit costs = 1.02^-(y-2025) * sum_c w_c c_{c,y} from the production-read SRP1_ESS.xlsx, w = investment-cost scenario probabilities; common installation year; granules 0.25 MVA / 0.5 MWh; E/P in [2, 4] h; E <= 5 MWh; I(x) <= 1e6 EUR
